title: Defer heavy report plugins on a degraded scheduled run
notes: On 2026-11-23 02:15 the preflight was degraded (load_above_cpu_count): 25 run plugins were deferred, yet report_mole still ran 1800 s and timed out, the heaviest step of the night.
Smallest next step: a plugin metadata flag (e.g. PLUGIN_HEAVY=true on mole) that ROCKETUPDATER_DEFER_RUN_ACTIONS also skips in RocketUpdater.sh near the report branch.
done_when: A degraded scheduled run skips report_mole and a runner test covers it
